id: \bDue to a loss of supply from a Snorlax we need to pick faster than ever.
en: \bDue to a loss of supply from a Snorlax we need to pick faster than ever.
it: \bA causa delle scorte perse per colpa di uno Snorlax, dobbiamo raccogliere più in fretta che mai.

id: \bWe found this when we were picking. We don't need it though.
en: \bWe found this when we were picking. We don't need it though.
it: \bL'abbiamo trovato mentre raccoglievamo. A noi però non serve.

id: \bNeed to pick faster now. Talking to you took time.
en: \bNeed to pick faster now. Talking to you took time.
it: \bOra devo raccogliere più in fretta. Parlare con te mi ha fatto perdere tempo.

id: \bWant to help me pick some?
en: \bWant to help me pick some?
it: \bVuoi aiutarmi a raccoglierne un po'?

id: \bDodrio
en: \bDodrio
it: \bDodrio

id: \bThere's a rampant Snorlax this way. It's best to stay back.
en: \bThere's a rampant Snorlax this way. It's best to stay back.
it: \bDa questa parte c'è uno Snorlax scatenato. Meglio stare alla larga.

id: \bSnorlax is strong. Be careful.
en: \bSnorlax is strong. Be careful.
it: \bSnorlax è forte. Fai attenzione.

id: \bGood job on stopping Snorlax.
en: \bGood job on stopping Snorlax.
it: \bOttimo lavoro con Snorlax.

id: \bDonphan
en: \bDonphan
it: \bDonphan

id: \rWe just picked some grapefruits here yesterday.
en: \rWe just picked some grapefruits here yesterday.
it: \rProprio ieri abbiamo raccolto dei pompelmi qui.

id: \rThese are the Seven Grapefruit Islands. You can tell by the name that they grow grapefruits here.
en: \rThese are the Seven Grapefruit Islands. You can tell by the name that they grow grapefruits here.
it: \rQueste sono le Sette Isole Grapefruit. Dal nome si capisce che qui si coltivano pompelmi.

id: \bWhat will happen if this keeps going?
en: \bWhat will happen if this keeps going?
it: \bCosa succederà se continua così?

id: \bLook at what happened to all our grapefruits when a Snorlax came.
en: \bLook at what happened to all our grapefruits when a Snorlax came.
it: \bGuarda cos'è successo a tutti i nostri pompelmi quando è arrivato uno Snorlax.

id: \bI decided to stop here before going to the Navel Gym.
en: \bI decided to stop here before going to the Navel Gym.
it: \bHo deciso di fermarmi qui prima di andare alla Palestra di Navel.

id: \bThe islands to the east of us were hit pretty hard.
en: \bThe islands to the east of us were hit pretty hard.
it: \bLe isole a est di qui sono state colpite duramente.

id: \bThere's no grapefruits left over there.
en: \bThere's no grapefruits left over there.
it: \bLaggiù non sono rimasti più pompelmi.

id: ... The Snorlax is fast asleep.
en: ... The Snorlax is fast asleep.
it: ... Lo Snorlax dorme profondamente.

id: Would you like to take Snorlax with you?
en: Would you like to take Snorlax with you?
it: Vuoi portare Snorlax con te?

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

id: No
en: No
it: No
